questions.q: What does one brackish drop from a vessel of water tell us?
options: That the vessel is cracked
Not quite. The article says: That all the water is undrinkable.
That all the water is undrinkable
So one drop of behaviour reveals the personality.
That only that drop is bad
Not quite. The article says: That all the water is undrinkable.
Nothing certain
Not quite. The article says: That all the water is undrinkable.
questions.rationale: If from a vessel containing water a single drop is found to be brackish, it means that all of the liquid is undrinkable.
